Here is your curated weekly events digest for **Brisbane, 11–17 May 2026**, compiled from searches across all listed institutional sources. Events are confirmed from their official source pages.

---

# 🗓️ Brisbane Events Digest — 11–17 May 2026

---

## 🎭 Arts / Exhibition

---

### 1. Olafur Eliasson: Presence (Ongoing Exhibition)
- **Date:** Open throughout the week (until 30 Aug 2026)
- **Venue:** Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
- **Cost:** Ticketed (entry fee applies)
- **Category:** Arts / Exhibition
- **Source:** qagoma.qld.gov.au
- **URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/whats-on/exhibitions/

Wander through the immersive installations of Olafur Eliasson at GOMA — exclusive to Brisbane. "Presence" displays major works by one of contemporary art's pre-eminent figures, from large-scale works that play with light, colour and perception to a meticulously constructed riverbed — the exhibition comes to life as we move through it and experience each moment in succession.

---

### 2. GOMA Friday Nights — Olafur Eliasson: Presence
- **Date:** Friday 15 May 2026, 5:30–8:30 PM
- **Venue:** Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
- **Cost:** Ticketed
- **Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Social
- **Source:** qagoma.qld.gov.au
- **URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/event/goma-friday-nights-presence-2026-05-08

GOMA is open every Friday night from 1 May until 26 June during 'Olafur Eliasson: Presence'. Step into the multi-sensory art of Eliasson, meet up with friends, and enjoy drinks and delicious bites at bespoke bars. Each week, Brisbane's best selectors take over the Vinyl Listening Bar, DJs set the mood in the River Room, and live performances pop up across the gallery — a unique and unmissable night out featuring art, music and connection.

---

### 3. Kids Tour: Presence & Play (Family Art Tour)
- **Date:** Saturday 16 May 2026, 8:30–10:00 AM
- **Venue:** Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
- **Cost:** From $19 (various tiers)
- **Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Workshop
- **Source:** qagoma.qld.gov.au
- **URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/event/kids-tours-presence-and-play-2026-07-04

Designed for families with children, these multi-sensory tours of 'Olafur Eliasson: Presence' invite you to explore art through play. Together, you'll be guided through playful experiences that immerse you in art, spark your imagination and build connection in a relaxed, family-friendly setting. After the tour, families enjoy exclusive exhibition viewing — experiencing the magic of 'Presence' in a crowd-free setting before the Gallery opens to the public.

---

### 4. Double Take — Australian Cinémathèque Film Program
- **Dates:** Running 1 May – 1 July 2026 (screenings across the week)
- **Venue:** Australian Cinémathèque, Gallery of Modern Art, South Bank
- **Cost:** Ticketed
- **Category:** Arts / Exhibition (Film)
- **Source:** qagoma.qld.gov.au
- **URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/stories/top-5-things-to-see-and-do-at-qagoma-in-may-2026

The Australian Cinémathèque at the Gallery of Modern Art presents 'Double Take' — running 1 May to 1 July 2026. This curated cinema program at GOMA is a fixture for film lovers seeking thoughtful, artistically selected screenings in an intimate gallery setting.

---

## 🎶 Concert / Music

---

### 5. QSO Concert Special: The Italian Job (Rossini / Rota / Verdi / Vivaldi)
- **Date:** Friday 15 May 2026, 7:30 PM
- **Venue:** QPAC Concert Hall, South Bank
- **Cost:** Ticketed (selling fast)
- **Category:** Concert / Music
- **Source:** qso.com.au
- **URL:** https://qso.com.au/events/2026/concert-specials-2026

The Queensland Symphony Orchestra presents a Concert Special on 15 May 2026 at 7:30 PM — featuring a programme of Rossini, Rota, Verdi and Vivaldi (arr. Crabb). A celebratory Italian-themed orchestral evening at QPAC's Concert Hall.

---

### 6. La Boite / Queensland Theatre: *Shad & Pete Save the World!*
- **Dates:** Running 8–22 May 2026 (multiple performances across the week)
- **Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
- **Cost:** Ticketed
- **Category:** Concert / Music / Theatre
- **Source:** brisbanepowerhouse.org
- **URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org

As part of Brisbane Comedy Festival, *Shad & Pete Save the World!* runs 8–22 May 2026 at Brisbane Powerhouse. A late-night raw variety comedy musical — part of the Comedy Festival's diverse program.

---

## 🎤 Comedy / Live Performance (Brisbane Comedy Festival)

Brisbane Comedy Festival runs **20 April – 24 May 2026** across Brisbane Powerhouse and other venues. The following shows have confirmed performances during 11–17 May:

---

### 7. Bron Lewis — Stand-Up Comedy
- **Dates:** Thu 14 May 7 PM | Fri 15 May 7 PM | Sat 16 May 7 PM | Sun 17 May 6 PM
- **Venue:** Underground Theatre, Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
- **Cost:** $30 (Thu) / $35 (Fri, Sat, Sun)
- **Category:** Concert / Music (Live Performance / Comedy)
- **Source:** brisbanepowerhouse.org
- **URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org/events/bron-lewis/

Bron Lewis performs Thursday 14 May at 7:00 PM, Friday 15 May at 7:00 PM, Saturday 16 May at 7:00 PM, and Sunday 17 May at 6:00 PM in the Underground Theatre. Bron Lewis' life is complete and utter chaos, just ask her dog trainer. She has three kids — an emotional tweenager, a four-year-old stalker and a middle one — and just when things couldn't get any harder, she bought a puppy. A glutton for punishment, Bron has welcomed the flourishing of her comedy career.

---

### 8. NPC (Nearly Proficient Comedian) — Comedy Workshop / Showcase
- **Dates:** Running 7 May – 14 Nov 2026 (weekly at Brisbane Powerhouse)
- **Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
- **Cost:** Ticketed
- **Category:** Workshop / Class / Comedy
- **Source:** brisbanepowerhouse.org
- **URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org

NPC (Nearly Proficient Comedian) runs as part of Brisbane Comedy Festival, with performances across the entire festival season at Brisbane Powerhouse. A recurring comedy development showcase — ideal for anyone curious about the craft of stand-up and new voices.

---

### 9. Katabasis — Brisbane Writers Festival (IDEAS Program)
- **Date:** Tuesday 12 May 2026
- **Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
- **Cost:** Ticketed
- **Category:** Public Lecture / IDEAS
- **Source:** brisbanepowerhouse.org
- **URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org

Katabasis appears in the Brisbane Writers Festival IDEAS program on 12 May at Brisbane Powerhouse. The Brisbane Writers Festival IDEAS program is known for intellectually stimulating talks and panels across literature, culture, and ideas — exactly the kind of event for curious, thoughtful audiences.

---

## 🏛️ Public Lecture / Talk

---

### 10. ADFAS Lecture: *The World's Greatest Paintings — 200 Years of the National Gallery*
- **Date (Evening):** Wednesday 14 May 2026, 7:30 PM
  **Date (Morning):** Thursday 15 May 2026, 10:00 AM
- **Venue:** Wed: Royal Queensland Art Society, 3/162 Petrie Terrace, Brisbane | Thu: State Library of Queensland Auditorium 1, Stanley Place, South Bank
- **Cost:** Members (contact for pricing); guest attendance may be possible
- **Category:** Public Lecture
- **Source:** artsnational.au
- **URL:** https://www.artsnational.au/societies/brisbane/

The lecture 'The World's Greatest Paintings: 200 Years of the National Gallery', presented by Simon Whitehouse, is on Wednesday 14 May at 7:30 PM at the Royal QLD Art Society, and Thursday 15 May at 10 AM at QLD State Library Auditorium 1. It tells the story of the NG collection's establishment in 1824 and examines the gallery's early years including suffragette sabotage, bombs and theft — looking at some of the original 'Angerstein 38' paintings. Simon is a (recovering) actor, presenter, Alexander Technique and voice teacher, and award-winning London Blue Badge guide.

---

### 11. Inspiring Future Skills Symposium 2026 — Brisbane
- **Date:** Monday 11 May 2026, 8:30 AM – 3:30 PM
- **Venue:** QUT Kelvin Grove Campus, Kelvin Grove
- **Cost:** Ticketed (teacher PD event)
- **Category:** Workshop / Class / Public Lecture
- **Source:** eventbrite.com.au
- **URL:** https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/inspiring-future-skills-symposium-2026-brisbane-tickets-1983053099202

The Inspiring Future Skills 2026 Symposium is a hands-on, teacher-focused professional learning experience designed to help Queensland educators confidently embed future skills into everyday classroom practice. It brings together education leaders, curriculum innovators, and industry experts to explore how emerging technologies and industry-relevant skills can enhance teaching — across AI, big data, quantum computing, robotics and augmented reality. Best suited to educators, but open to anyone with an interest in technology, pedagogy and the future of learning.

---

## 🎼 Vertigo — Sky-High Dining Experience

### 12. Vertigo Rooftop Dining (Thu–Sun this week)
- **Dates:** Thu 14 May 6:30–9 PM | Fri 15 May 6:30–9 PM | Sat 16 May 6:30–9 PM | Sun 17 May 5:30–8 PM
- **Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse Rooftop, New Farm
- **Cost:** Premium dining (ticketed)
- **Category:** Community / Other (Adventure dining)
- **Source:** brisbanepowerhouse.org
- **URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org/neighbourhood/

Combining high adventure with fine dining, guests are escorted to the rooftop where they don safety harnesses and climb out to their seats to experience sky-high city views and a 17-metre drop beneath their feet. Adventurers are served a meal crafted by Brisbane Powerhouse restaurant Bar Alto using local ingredients. Once dinner is complete, diners have the option to descend through Brisbane Powerhouse or end the meal with one final adrenalin burst by dropline down the building's façade.

---

## 📚 Community / Ongoing Programs

---

### 13. State Library of Queensland — Digital & You Workshops (Queensland Small Business Month)
- **Dates:** Various throughout May 2026
- **Venue:** State Library of Queensland, South Bank (and regional)
- **Cost:** Free
- **Category:** Workshop / Class
- **Source:** slq.qld.gov.au
- **URL:** https://www.slq.qld.gov.au/blog/supporting-queensland-small-businesses-free-and-practical-digital-skills

This Queensland Small Business Month, State Library of Queensland's Digital and You program is supporting small businesses through free workshops, online learning, and mentoring. Delivered as part of State Library's Regional Digital Development project, the focus is on skills that save time, reduce pressure and help business owners make confident decisions. State Library's 'Digital Power Hour' is a series of fun and fast online workshops designed to help small businesses, community groups, and individuals build practical digital skills in just one hour — held on Sunday mornings, covering Canva design techniques, digital marketing basics, templates, branding and more.

---

### 14. QAGOMA: Free Guided Volunteer Tours (Queensland Art Gallery)
- **Dates:** Available during opening hours throughout the week
- **Venue:** Queensland Art Gallery (QAG), South Bank
- **Cost:** Free
- **Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Community
- **Source:** qagoma.qld.gov.au
- **URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/event/guided-tour-art-in-focus-qag-one-pm-autumn-2026-2026-04-19

Free volunteer guided tours journey through a personally selected collection of noteworthy artworks, with a focus on the stories, symbols, and perspectives behind each piece — uncovering the context and artistic choices that shape the works, offering fresh insights along the way. No two tours are the same, making each visit a unique experience. Attendees are encouraged to participate in conversations with fellow attendees and the facilitator. You can participate in discussion, ask questions, or just listen — and you're welcome to come alone.

---

### 15. Brisbane Writers Festival at Brisbane Powerhouse (Running Programme)
- **Dates:** Ongoing into mid-May 2026
- **Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
- **Cost:** Varies (many events free or low cost)
- **Category:** Public Lecture / Community
- **Source:** brisbanepowerhouse.org
- **URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org/brisbane-writers-festival/

Brisbane Writers Festival has moved to Brisbane Powerhouse — "the visually stunning Brisbane Powerhouse is well established as one of the most popular and exciting event destinations in our city." After two years of record-breaking ticket sales, the festival now offers larger theatres, more intimate event spaces and expanded dining options. The central Turbine Platform at Brisbane Powerhouse is transformed into a giant bookshop operated by Avid Reader & Riverbend Books, two of Brisbane's most beloved independent bookstores.

---

## 🎠 South Bank / Parklands

### 16. South Bank Events: Free & Ongoing (Guided Museum Tours, Exhibitions)
- **Dates:** Throughout the week (various)
- **Venue:** South Bank Parklands precinct
- **Cost:** Free / low cost
- **Category:** Community / Other
- **Source:** visitsouthbank.com.au
- **URL:** https://www.visitsouthbank.com.au/whats-on

South Bank this week includes free guided museum tours and ongoing art & culture exhibitions throughout 5–22 May 2026. The South Bank precinct also hosts QAGOMA, Queensland Museum, and a range of cultural venues all within easy walking distance.

**⚠️ A note on sourcing:** University events pages (QUT, UQ, Griffith) returned only internal or past events for this specific week — nothing new public-facing fell squarely in 11–17 May that matched your interests.
